question.text: The 'priority distribution model' in which one class of investors shares loss more than pro-rata is:

answer.text: Not permitted in any Category III AIF scheme; existing schemes cannot take fresh commitments

explanation.text: **The Logic:** SEBI Circular dated November 23, 2022 barred Category III AIFs from adopting priority distribution models; schemes that had adopted it cannot accept fresh commitments or make new investee investments. **The Trap:** There is NO blanket approval route; LVFs are not exempted from this restriction. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same ban applies to Cat I/II under XIX-A. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Losses must be shared strictly pro-rata to holdings — flag any PPM draft proposing priority loss-sharing immediately.
